svg.text: YouTube → LangGraph → dev.to, with a human in the loop · Google Cloud, us-east1 · everything authenticates with ADC, no key files

① sign-in & app traffic → ④ API enqueues a graph segment → ⑤ Cloud Tasks pushes it to the worker → ⑥ LangGraph runs until the next human approval → ⑦ YouTube · LLMs · dev.to → ⑧ state checkpointed to Cloud SQL, text to GCS → events stream back over SSE
Icons: Google Cloud & Firebase official icons (via mingrammer/diagrams), Next.js, FastAPI; brand logos from Simple Icons (CC0).
